services.desc: Animals are a part of the Township as pets, livestock and wildlife. The Township provides canine control services, distributes licences for kennels and backyard hens, and has a by-law to manage exotic pets. All dogs in the Township are required to have a dog tag. By-law Enforcement is responsible for canine control within the Township of Wilmot. Any resident who has lost their dog should contact By-law Enforcement or the KW Humane Society. Canine control concerns like noise, kennels, dogs at large and dog waste can be reported to By-law Enforcement or through our Report a Problem form.
